# TenkaCloud

> A multi-tenant SaaS cloud-competition platform on AWS. Teams solve real cloud problems delivered as **Battle** (real-time, head-to-head) or **Challenge** (self-paced, evergreen). Built on the AWS SaaS Builder Toolkit (`@cdklabs/sbt-aws`); the Control Plane, Application Plane, and per-competitor problem deployment are all expressed in AWS CDK.

> 日本語: TenkaCloud は、本物の AWS 環境で Battle (リアルタイム対戦) と Challenge (自習型演習) を開催するための、Apache 2.0 のオープンソース・クラウド実戦演習プラットフォームです。

TenkaCloud's core extension model is its open problem catalog: a problem is a plugin (`metadata.json` + a single-page CloudFormation `template.yaml` + optional portal slots), and the platform is the host that deploys it into a competitor's own AWS account, scores it, and renders the competitor portal. Every backend is an AWS Lambda (Hono); the frontends are Vite + React + Cloudscape SPAs. DynamoDB tables are forced to PROVISIONED 1/1 to stay inside the AWS Free Tier. There are two deploy modes: **Lite** (single-tenant, one organizer, ~10 min) and **SaaS** (full multi-tenant, pooled + silo tiers).

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention. Links point to the canonical sources in the GitHub repository. The expanded, self-contained agent briefing — including step-by-step play/host quick starts and instructions for guiding a human — is [llms-full.txt](https://tenkacloud.com/llms-full.txt); hand that file (or its URL) to an AI agent such as Claude Code or Codex and it can explain and onboard TenkaCloud on its own.

## Start here

- [Landing page — 日本語](https://tenkacloud.com/?lang=ja): AWS クラウド実戦演習、Battle / Challenge、料金、導入方法
- [Landing page — English](https://tenkacloud.com/index.en.html): product overview, Battle / Challenge modes, pricing, and deployment model
- [README](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloud/blob/main/README.md): project overview, quick start, and command reference

## Book

- [Build Your Own Cloud Competition (English)](https://leanpub.com/build-your-own-cloud-competition): the design decisions and implementation journey behind TenkaCloud, written by its author. Background reading, **not** a specification — the repository is the source of truth for current behaviour, and the book may describe an earlier shape of the system.
- [『自分で作るクラウド競技』(日本語)](https://zenn.dev/bull/books/cloud-competition): the same material in Japanese. Same caveat: read it for why, read the repository for what.

## Contributing & extending

- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloud/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, development flow, gates, and community roles
- [Competitor-side setup](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloud/blob/main/infrastructure/templates/README.md): the least-privilege IAM role to roll out in a competitor account

## Authoring problems

- [Problem catalog repo (TenkaCloudChallenge)](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloudChallenge#readme): where competition problems live and are contributed
- [Problem schema + conventions](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloud/blob/main/problems/README.md): `metadata.json` schema and `template.yaml` conventions
